beats.text: Does your blood pressure **dip** while you sleep?

beats.label: The setup
beats.text: **4,190** adults with high blood pressure wore a **wrist tracker** plus a BP cuff for a **year.**
beats.note: Chaudhry et al., AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 abstract

beats.label: No night dip
beats.text: Blood pressure that didn't fall during sleep went with nearly **5x** the odds of a **crisis.**

beats.label: The AI alert
beats.text: An AI flagged high-risk patients up to **3 days** early. Fast doctor follow-up went with **61%** fewer crises.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: One hospital in **Pakistan.** An early **abstract,** not yet peer reviewed, and it needs testing in more groups.
Follow for **wellness tech** that's been put to the test.
